situation: I walk into a party where I only know one person
behavior: I work the room and start conversations with strangers

situation: I have an unexpected free evening
behavior: I text a few friends to see who's around to grab a drink

situation: I'm in a meeting and an idea pops into my head
behavior: I share it out loud right away

situation: I'm waiting in line and the person next to me catches my eye
behavior: I strike up a friendly conversation with them

situation: A friend asks me to host a dinner for ten people
behavior: I say yes immediately and start planning

situation: I have a long stretch alone with no plans
behavior: I start feeling restless and look for someone to spend time with

situation: Someone tells a story to a small group
behavior: I jump in with a related story of my own

situation: I'm asked to give a toast on short notice
behavior: I stand up grinning and improvise something

situation: I see a group laughing across the room
behavior: I drift over to find out what's funny

situation: I finish a long focused work session
behavior: I want to call someone or get out of the house immediately
